about: The first-visit intro: five cards, shown once on the home page and as a section of /about. Each card has a title, one sentence, an image reference and a status: 'live' (it points at something that exists now) or 'coming'. Card 1 must keep the independence and no-token line (npm run check:intro). Images are references: 'published:<id>' is a seeded image in content/snowmoon/illustrations/published.json; Design's cards will replace them.
model_drafted_note: Drafted by the coding agent (Claude, a closed model) on Oct 6, 2026. Shown labelled as model-drafted until the owner edits it; set model_drafted to false, with edited_by_fid and edited_on, when they do.

cards.title: An open Snowmoon
cards.sentence: An independent, illustrated edition of Vitalik Buterin's novel, not affiliated with the author, and there is no token.

cards.title: Read and listen
cards.sentence: Read every chapter as written, with a synthetic narration that follows along paragraph by paragraph.

cards.title: Share a passage
cards.sentence: Choose a passage and an image to make a quote card, then cast it or save it to the gallery.

cards.title: Adaptations
cards.sentence: Read briefs for retelling scenes from the book, with every detail cited to the passage it comes from.

cards.title: Make your own
cards.sentence: Soon you will be able to propose images and write lines of your own, published under GPL-3.0 with your name.
